source.title: Open Problems for Polynomials over Finite Fields and Applications

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 6447838. The zbMATH API identified the work as Daniel Panario, 'Open Problems for Polynomials over Finite Fields and Applications', DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-10683-0_6, in Open Problems in Mathematics and Computational Science, pages 111-126.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted / metadata_only. The Springer DOI landing page was reachable as a chapter page but exposed only abstract, references, citation metadata, and subscription/purchase prompts, not full chapter text. Crossref confirmed only the DOI, title, publisher resource URL, and a Springer PDF link. OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, no best_oa_location, no repository full text, and no pdf_url for the primary location.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by exact title, DOI, and title plus author. Rejected candidates included ResearchGate because it was request-only and abstract/metadata-only, MaRDI because it was metadata-only and linked back to the DOI, DBLP because it was a bibliographic resolver without a readable document, and an exact-title Sambuz slide deck because it is a separate 2015 presentation artifact rather than the exact DOI chapter or an authorized full-text copy of that chapter.
No document map was produced because no readable primary PDF or full HTML source for the exact zbMATH/DOI work was recovered.

Candidate extraction was not performed. Per the source-adequacy and no-new-facts gates, questions were not extracted from abstracts, bibliographic metadata, search snippets, resolver records, references, or the rejected separate presentation artifact.

Extraction stopped before accepted-question generation because the bounded recovery pass did not recover a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the chapter's problem statements. Accepted output is empty and the run is marked for review with invalid_or_unreadable_input.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/6447838.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
